Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.q1: How do I use a discount at the venue?
Faq.a1: Before you pay, open the virtual card on your phone and show it to the staff. The card shows your name, member number and a live clock, so you don't need coupons or codes.
Faq.q2: Can I cancel at any time?
Faq.a2: Yes. Cancel from your member area in one click. Your access stays active until the end of the period you've already paid for.
Faq.q3: Which payment methods do you accept?
Faq.a3: Debit or credit card and SEPA Direct Debit, processed by Stripe. We never store your card details.
Faq.q4: I run a business. How do I become a partner?
Faq.a4: Joining is free for partners. Fill in a short request in the partner area and the club team publishes your offer once it's approved.
